headline: Markets see volatile trends as Reliance Industries Q2 results and IndiGo gains take center stage

marketStatus.message: Market is open for trading today.

why: FMCG and financial stocks led a strong rally pushing Nifty above 22,900 in recent sessions
Elevated crude oil prices and rising VIX created downward market pressure in earlier trades
Rupee strengthened 7 paise to 95.19 against the US dollar in early trade
Smallcap stocks outperformed largecaps, generating 60 multibaggers since last Diwali despite market routs
whatHappening: Reliance Industries is set to announce its Q2 financial results today
IndiGo shares jumped 2% as the airline reported narrowed losses in Q2
Four SME IPOs, including Maxwell Engineering and HGS India, opened today to raise Rs 201 crore
VC firm One Planet Partners announced plans to deploy over Rs 3,000 crore in high-growth Indian businesses
summary: Reliance Industries Q2 results are in focus today as markets trade amidst mixed signals ahead of Diwali. IndiGo shares gained 2% following narrowed quarterly losses, while rupee strengthened against the US dollar. Primary market activity remains brisk with four new SME IPOs opening today.
